status: Opt-in prototype; H3 BF16 Sol default preserved. No public release or local attention promotion.
tested_hardware: 4x RTX 5090, same retained four executor processes across all modes
request: Two matched warm action scenes, identical per-scene input/seed; 15-second request,1344x768,362 frames at24fps,Turbo8 with4 dense and4 sparse steps

arithmetic.kitchen-sol-sage: Kitchen signed INT8 Q/K/V and unsigned8 probability carriers with INT32 MMA accumulation
arithmetic.sol-fp8-fp16: FP8 exact QK/PV with FP16 tile accumulation; original BF16/F32 routing and approximate tail; FP32 outer softmax/output state
arithmetic.dense_reference: All modes retain Sage dense steps/refiner/protected rows; same sparse eligibility and current-call statistics. No chunked producer or prior-call statistics reuse.

interpretation: Measured backend comparison in this four-GPU Turbo workload, not a universal hardware throughput ratio or an isolated causal share for arithmetic precision. Two warm scenes per mode; no statistical population claim.

media.visual_quality: Sixteen matched snapshots per clip preserve overall sparring poses/clothing and rally trajectories across modes; no obvious variant-specific gross collapse was seen. Fine hands/contact and continuous temporal quality were not certified. This is not quality equivalence.
media.subjective_audio: Not performed; original audio and full decoding evidence retained.
media.numeric_drift: Optional full decoded RGB/PCM drift metrics are still computing; no acceptance conclusion is based on them.

known_limits: Generic Triton FP8 kernel is not a tuned CuTe implementation.

Kitchen adapter calls Sage directly; nested Sage is omitted from its implementation-string observer. Exact source, executed counters and dense_reference confessions verify the callback; no GPU profiling trace is claimed.
Triton3.8 CPU interpreter BF16 dot/FP8 rounding limitations were retained as failures, not disguised with wider tolerances; actualGPU admission passed.
Full decoding and pixel/signal similarity do not establish subjective quality equivalence.
